ai.summary: The page https://www.thetrevorproject.org/ loaded in the headless browser with HTTP 200 in about 7.5 seconds. No FundraiseUp installation code was found in the page source, and no FundraiseUp widget request was recorded. The verdict is not installed. Google Tag Manager, GA4, and Meta Pixel were found and loaded. No other donation tool was found on the page. The page load time is over the 6 second threshold. A plain HTTP client received HTTP 403 from the linked donate page, so that page could not be read without JavaScript. No consent tool was detected. The browser did not click any buttons, so it did not test whether any checkout or donate button works. Two console errors were recorded.

customer_email.subject: Next steps for installing FundraiseUp on thetrevorproject.org
customer_email.body:
Hello,

Thank you for working with us on your FundraiseUp launch. We checked https://www.thetrevorproject.org/ in a headless browser. The FundraiseUp installation code was not found in the page source, so the widget is not yet installed.

Please do the following:

1. Add the FundraiseUp installation code to the page source so it loads on https://www.thetrevorproject.org/.
2. Check the donate page at give.thetrevorproject.org. It returned HTTP 403 to our non-browser check. Please confirm it loads normally for visitors.

Once the code is in place, we will run the check again. Please reply if you have questions.

Thank you,
Onboarding Team
